description: Determinism hardening configuration. Feature flags control rollout of new behaviors.

quant_gates.description: Minimum discovered trial budgets for interpretive quant run classes. A quick:true artifact blocks serious_search and promotion_candidate regardless of these thresholds. Quant gate compatibility windows warn through policy version 1 and block from policy version 2.

state_json.description: Write canonical state.json alongside state.md on every transition

decision_logs.description: Append-only decision log (inputs → checks → decision → next_state) per transition

failure_codes.description: Emit stable failure codes (GATE-XXX-NNN) alongside human messages

sorted_output.description: Sort file paths, findings, and checklist items before writing results

proof_traces.description: Persist Prolog proof traces under plans/<plan>/artifacts/prolog/

script_hashing.description: Record script content hash + version in state.json when transitions run

prolog_shadow_mode.description: RT-REDTEAM-M6: Run Prolog transition checks in parallel with JS gate logic to detect divergence

prolog_enforce_mode.description: M4-FIX: When enabled, Prolog/JS divergence BLOCKS transitions instead of warning. Prevents an LLM from tampering with JS gate logic while Prolog disagrees.

strict_state_json.description: RT-REDTEAM-H1: Require all transitions to read/write ONLY state.json (not state.md) — state.md fallback removed

tool_trace.description: RT-REDTEAM-C4: Capture tool call traces via IDE hooks and verify file-read coverage at gate transitions (enabled by default)

gate_retry_cooldown.description: AV-19 time-based same-gate retry cooldown. DISABLED by default per ceremony-reduction ticket T-INTAKE-8CD950E7 (decision 2026-06-10): the persistent circuit breaker (CIRCUIT_BREAKER_OPEN at 10 total fails) and the GATE-RETRY-001 consecutive-thrash guard already catch brute-force retry loops, while the wall-clock cooldown only added dead time to honest fix-and-retry loops (dogfood friction_log F5: two attempts wasted purely on cooldown). Set enabled:true to restore the 10s cooldown.

proof_telemetry.description: Advisory-first proof telemetry: capture compact trusted work signals under plans/<plan>/telemetry/ so planner_findings can detect missing proof from actual work.

llm_run_telemetry.description: Append-only per-plan LLM run ledger. Defaults to hashes plus redacted excerpts; full redacted prompt/response text requires raw_storage_acknowledgement=I_UNDERSTAND_RAW_LLM_TELEMETRY_STORAGE.

suggestion_engine.description: Prolog-driven skill suggestions, completeness scoring, and auto-approve decisions

strict_trace_ide.description: L1-FIX + RT-HARDENING-005: GATE-TRC-009 (unsupported IDE) is FAIL when enabled. Disabled: Claude Code (VSCode extension) does not set TERM_PROGRAM=vscode in subprocess env, causing false-positive FAIL even when traces are being captured. Re-enable if running in a verified non-Claude-Code environment.

reachability_audit.description: RT-HARDENING-007: Exhaustive state-space reachability analysis at gate transitions. Detects deadlocks, forbidden paths, gate bypasses, and privilege escalation routes.

compact_low_risk_verification_matrix.description: Allow docs/chore/analysis/static-artifact plans to satisfy context-sensitive verification with one explicit low-risk obligation while integration, quant, security, backend, migration, and data-loss shapes keep the full matrix.

approval.comment: auto = transition writes [APPROVED] directly (solo autopilot default, no daemon needed); interactive = user/daemon must approve; multi-agent = story review agent (v3.9.0)
